info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List File Payment Consent Files-spec
info.description: The File Payment Consent Retrieval API enables users to access and view specific file payment consent files associated with a given parameter. This API is crucial for financial institutions and service providers involved in open banking processes who require verification of payment consents. By leveraging this endpoint, developers can integrate functionality to fetch consent files, ensuring compliance and transparency in payment operations. Typical consumers include banking applications and financial service platforms that adhere to Payment Initiation Service Provider (PISP) regulations.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific file payment consent.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the details of a specific file payment consent using its unique identifier. It returns all relevant information associated with the consent, facilitating review and processing.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve a file associated with the specified payment consent. It requires the consent ID to locate the appropriate file.

200.description: The request was successful and the file details are returned.

ListFilePaymentConsentFilesRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on file payment consents. It is expected to be a string containing the necessary information related to the file payment consent.

ListFilePaymentConsentFilesResponse_200.title: File Payment Consent Response
